A draft on a form of the list (`form_code`), in the patient's language (`CONSENT_TEXT_MISSING` when the form has
no text in it: `details.available`), for an admission (the general consent needs one), an operation, an ER visit or

POST /consents/{consent_id}/sign.description:
After the paper is signed. `signer`: the patient, or when the patient cannot decide a decision maker the policy
allows for this patient (`CONSENT_SIGNER_INVALID`: a minor alone, a relationship the policy does not allow, the same
doctor as second doctor). With the questions asked and the answers, and the understanding confirmed (MSDS 35 ii, 43
iii). A thumb impression and the forms that say so need a witness. `mode: EmergencyNote`: nobody could consent and
the treatment could not wait; a doctor writes why, and a second registered doctor concurs when the hospital says so.
The caller is the professional who explained it and is stamped on it: a registered doctor for an informed consent,
a doctor of the anaesthesia team for anaesthesia (`CONSENT_TAKER_NOT_AUTHORIZED`). What is missing:
`CONSENT_INCOMPLETE` with `details.missing`. Final afterwards: scan the paper (`POST .../scan`).
`CONSENT_STATE_INVALID`: the consent cannot change that way: a decided consent is final (withdraw it and take a new
one).

**Required permission:** `consent.record`

**Required permission:** `consent.record`

POST /consents/{consent_id}/refuse.description:
The patient (or the person deciding for them) was told the same and refuses: the reason in their words, signed;
`mode: VerbalRefusal` when they would not sign (a witness is required). Final.
`CONSENT_INCOMPLETE`: the consent is missing what the form needs (details.missing lists it).

`CONSENT_STATE_INVALID`: the consent is already decided. `CONSENT_TAKER_NOT_AUTHORIZED`: this form is taken by a
doctor registered with the PMDC (or, for anaesthesia, a doctor of the anaesthesia team).
`CONSENT_SIGNER_INVALID`: the consent policy does not let this signer decide (a minor decides through a parent or
guardian; `details`).

**Required permission:** `consent.record`

**Required permission:** `consent.record`

POST /consents/{consent_id}/withdraw.description:
The patient changed their mind (or it was recorded in error): the consent no longer counts, with the reason and
the stamp of who recorded it. Not once its operation has started (`CONSENT_STATE_INVALID`). Take a new one if the
treatment goes ahead. A transfusion consent: every open blood request it covered is cancelled at once, unless a unit
is already out; then `blood.consent.withdrawn` tells the ward and the blood bank to sign it back or stop the
transfusion, and the database refuses to start it (`BLOOD_CONSENT_REQUIRED`).

**Required permission:** `consent.record`

**Required permission:** `consent.record`

POST /patients/{patient_id}/documents.description:
Stored in the protected patient vault; only its path and SHA-256 are in the database. Documents are PDF, JPEG or
PNG (a scan or a photo of the paper); `doc_type=Photo`, the Patient Photo, is a JPEG or PNG only, at most 16
megapixels. The Patient Photo is **optional** at registration, at admission and everywhere else: offer it, never
require it (an emergency, facial injuries, a patient who cannot cooperate or declines it: purdah, privacy). The
newest one is `photo_document_id` on the patient and on the admission.

Reports, tests and prescriptions the patient brings from elsewhere: `is_outside=true` with `source_facility`, the
date on the paper (`document_date`) and a `title` naming the test or report; `doc_type` `LabReport`, `Imaging`,
`DischargeSummary`, `Prescription`, `ReferralLetter` or `Other`. They stay attachments for the doctor to read, never
results of this hospital's laboratory or imaging.

`UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`: another file type, a PDF as the Photo, or content that is not the type the file claims;
`VALIDATION_ERROR`: a damaged or oversized image, an outside document without its facility, a Photo marked outside,
a date in the future; `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` above MAX_UPLOAD_MB; `NOT_FOUND`: no such patient.

**Required permission:** `patient.document.upload`

**Required permission:** `patient.document.upload`
